title: tag-team-championship-avw-2001
label: The Board of Education

won.source: The promotion's served card of 5 February 2001 (Appalachian Extreme).

lost.source: The titles were defended against Southern Tradition at Bluegrass Bash on 18 March 2001; that show's results were published only on the promotion's website and do not survive in the newsgroup.

how: Defeated Shaun Drake and Scott Justice with the K-12 Dropout, the first AVW Tag Team Championship match.
note: The first champions of the title.

title: appalachian-championship-avw-2001
label: Dan Debacle

won.source: The title was vacant in the promotion's update of 22 January 2001 and Debacle was defending it as champion on its card of 26 February 2001; the night he won it is not among the served cards.

lost.source: No title change survives in the served documents.

how: Champion by 26 February 2001, when a defence against Leevon Parks was broken up by Seth Alexander.
note: The first attested holder of the title.
